text:
### Core Requirements  
1. **Lawful Basis:** Data processed only for banking/regulatory purposes
2. **Transparency:** Clear privacy notices provided to customers
3. **Data Security:** Encryption and access controls
4. **Customer Rights:** Subject access requests processed within 30 days
5. **Retention:** Data retained only as long as necessary
6. **Consent Management:** Explicit consent for marketing communications

name: Chunk 6/36

raw_entities.name: Data Privacy and Protection Policy
raw_entities.description: A comprehensive policy governing the lawful processing, security, and retention of customer data within the bank. The policy establishes core requirements for transparency, data security, customer rights, and consent management in accordance with banking and regulatory standards.
context: Lawful Basis: Data processed only for banking/regulatory purposes
Transparency: Clear privacy notices provided to customers
Data Security: Encryption and access controls
Customer Rights: Subject access requests processed within 30 days

raw_entities.name: Lawful Basis for Data Processing
raw_entities.description: Establishes that all customer data must be processed exclusively for banking and regulatory purposes. This provision ensures the bank operates within legal boundaries when handling personal information.
context: Lawful Basis: Data processed only for banking/regulatory purposes

raw_entities.name: Transparency Through Privacy Notices
raw_entities.description: Requires the bank to provide clear and accessible privacy notices to all customers. This provision ensures customers are informed about how their data is collected, used, and protected.
context: Transparency: Clear privacy notices provided to customers

raw_entities.name: Data Security Through Encryption and Access Controls
raw_entities.description: Mandates implementation of encryption and access control mechanisms to protect customer data from unauthorized access and breach. This is a core technical safeguard requirement.
context: Data Security: Encryption and access controls

raw_entities.name: Subject Access Request Processing Timeframe
raw_entities.description: Establishes a mandatory 30-day processing window for customer subject access requests. This provision ensures timely fulfillment of customer rights to access their personal data.
context: Customer Rights: Subject access requests processed within 30 days

raw_entities.name: Data Retention Minimization
raw_entities.description: Requires the bank to retain customer data only for as long as necessary to fulfill banking and regulatory purposes. This provision implements the data minimization principle.
context: Retention: Data retained only as long as necessary

raw_entities.name: Explicit Consent for Marketing Communications
raw_entities.description: Mandates that the bank obtain explicit, informed consent from customers before sending marketing communications. This provision protects customer autonomy and complies with consent-based marketing standards.
context: Consent Management: Explicit consent for marketing communications

raw_entities.name: Data Encryption
raw_entities.description: A technical control requiring encryption of customer data to protect confidentiality and integrity. This safeguard prevents unauthorized access to sensitive banking information.
context: Data Security: Encryption and access controls

raw_entities.name: Access Control System
raw_entities.description: An operational control mechanism that restricts access to customer data based on role and necessity. This safeguard ensures only authorized personnel can view or modify sensitive information.
context: Data Security: Encryption and access controls

raw_entities.name: Data Protection Officer
raw_entities.description: An abstract role responsible for overseeing data protection compliance, privacy notice delivery, and customer rights fulfillment. The DPO ensures the bank meets all privacy and data security obligations.
context: Transparency: Clear privacy notices provided to customers
Customer Rights: Subject access requests processed within 30 days

raw_entities.name: All Staff
raw_entities.description: All bank employees are collectively responsible for adhering to data security, encryption, and access control requirements. Staff must respect customer privacy and handle data lawfully.
context: Data Security: Encryption and access controls
Lawful Basis: Data processed only for banking/regulatory purposes

raw_entities.name: Data Breach
raw_entities.description: The risk of unauthorized access to or compromise of customer personal data. This risk is mitigated through encryption, access controls, and data retention minimization.
context: Data Security: Encryption and access controls
Retention: Data retained only as long as necessary

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Data Processing
raw_entities.description: The risk that customer data is processed for purposes outside banking and regulatory functions. This risk is controlled through the lawful basis requirement and transparency measures.
context: Lawful Basis: Data processed only for banking/regulatory purposes
Transparency: Clear privacy notices provided to customers

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Marketing Communication
raw_entities.description: The risk of sending marketing communications to customers without their explicit consent. This risk is mitigated through mandatory consent management procedures.
context: Consent Management: Explicit consent for marketing communications

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: A natural person who holds a banking relationship with the bank and is subject to data privacy protections. Customers have rights to transparency, data security, and access to their personal information.
context: Transparency: Clear privacy notices provided to customers
Customer Rights: Subject access requests processed within 30 days
